large.scope: Exact rational Casimir moments and positive-deficit comparison bounds. These are not direct large-system rank-deficit moments or a Poisson-law test.

slopes.scope: Domination and positive-part/binomial agreement are exact rational checks. Exponential targets use precision refinement, not interval certification; finite-size deviations are retained without a convergence tolerance.

scope: Finite independent-copy positive rank laws and one-step transitions. The fixed-k high-moment theorem uses the existing polynomial-ring Racah cancellations on bounded charge/rank parameter sets; finite cases do not prove its uniformity. This driver does not prove an all-k sixth moment rate, a Poisson law, actual-exponential convergence, or a mixed kernel.
reproducibility: Deterministic exact arithmetic; no random seed or rank cutoff. No historical main function is executed. Output is exclusive-create.
